claim_boundary: This proves a finite signed projective packet-lift classifier for one compatible source packet/cross edge. It does not prove any compatible population, deep packet in the actual census, recurrence, skeleton, density, or interval gain.

exact_replay.boundary: This is a finite projective-lift classifier. It does not prove a compatible population, a mass lower bound, recurrence, skeleton, density, or interval gain.
exact_replay.classifier: seed/range, content, error-supported depth, and denominator capacity are ordered obstruction gates
exact_replay.depth: error-supported depth floor(g/Lambda), interpreted as infinity when Lambda=0, and denominator capacity floor(H/Q) are separate; their minimum certifies both the packet inequality and QK<=H
exact_replay.error: under |delta|<=C_S/(K_S X)<=1 and |qE-a|<=C_E/(K_E X), the full lifted error is at most Lambda/X and the reduced error at most Lambda/(gX)
exact_replay.identity: D alpha_L-N=a delta+(qE-a)(d+b+delta), with Q=|D|/g and A=sgn(D)N/g
exact_replay.seed: an integral reduced-rational edge carries the original beta seed to the target with its exact transported residual
